quotes.quote: We have run a 1000 ns molecular dynamic simulation on a model of the entire TSHR generated by merging the extracellular region of the receptor,
Figure 4A shows the 2D root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) map of the LR over 2000 evenly spaced conformations. The RMSDs are calculated for the LR backbones.

G1.rationale: The principal result is produced by MD simulation and trajectory analysis, which a third party can re-run if inputs are available.

quotes.quote: It shows remarkable fluctuations with the range (the difference between the highest and lowest value) of R g values being 6.4 Å. In contrast, the range of R g values was only 1.6 Å for the larger LRD (not shown).

In particular, the number of LR heavy atoms clashing with TSH, blocking antibody (PDB id 2xwt), and stimulating antibody (PDB id 3g04) were 40, 68, and 101, respectively and involved 7, 11, and 18 residues, respectively.

G2.rationale: A principal quantitative result is the range of radius of gyration values for the LR, reported as 6.4 Å.

quotes.quote: The simulations used the default parameters set by Charmm-gui. For the protein and the ions, the pairwise additive Charmm36m force field ( Huang et al., 2017 ) was used, and water was represented by the TIP3P water model ( Jorgensen et al., 1983 ).

Long-range electrostatics was treated with the Ewald method, and VdW interactions used a cutoff of 12 Â, smoothly cut to zero starting at 10 Â. The simulations used 2 fs time steps and were run in the (T, P, N) ensemble.

G4.rationale: The method section describes the simulation setup and analysis sufficiently to implement without original code.

quotes.quote: all using the program NAMD ( Phillips et al., 2005 ).
Most analyses were performed on the trajectories with the program Simulaid ( Mezei, 2010 ).

G5.rationale: NAMD and Simulaid are freely available; no proprietary software is required.

The simulations used the default parameters set by Charmm-gui. For the protein and the ions, the pairwise additive Charmm36m force field ( Huang et al., 2017 ) was used, and water was represented by the TIP3P water model ( Jorgensen et al., 1983 ).

specification.input_notes: The Dryad deposit (rjdfn2zdp) is listed but contains no files. The paper states only the initial model coordinates are deposited, not the simulation inputs or trajectory. Missing inputs include the initial full-length TSHR model coordinates, simulation parameters, and trajectory data.
specification.comparison_metric: The reported range of Rg values (6.4 Å) is compared to the range computed from the simulation trajectory.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Scalars within displayed rounding bin: the reported value 6.4 Å should match the computed range to one decimal place.
specification.specification_gaps: The exact method for calculating the range of Rg values (e.g., whether it is max-min over all frames) is not fully specified. The simulation protocol details (equilibration steps, production run length) are referenced but not fully described in the paper.
specification.alternatives_considered: Other quantitative results such as clash counts (40, 68, 101) or helix length changes were considered, but the Rg range is a principal quantitative result highlighted in the abstract and results.
